summary.name: Versions
summary.one_liner: Versions is a Mac client for working with Subversion (SVN) repositories, with Finder integration and a visual interface for commits, history, and file comparison.
use_cases: Committing and updating a team's SVN working copies on a Mac
Reverting files or browsing earlier revisions of artwork or documents
Comparing local changes or two revisions of a file
Locking binary files to prevent conflicting edits
Browsing and moving files in a repository without checking it out
Linking commit messages to an issue tracker
summary.what_it_does: Versions provides a graphical front end for Apache Subversion on macOS. Working copies show change badges in the Finder, and a Versions menu lets users update, commit, add, ignore, or revert without leaving Finder. The commit sheet lets users pick files, compare differences, and reuse recent messages. The Timeline shows revisions with author, message, and changed files, and can be searched by message, author, path, revision, or date. Users can also browse repositories without checking them out, set svn:ignore and other properties, lock and unlock files, and drag files in or out to import or export them. Subversion itself is built in, so no separate install is needed.
notable: Finder integration with change badges and a Versions menu for SVN actions
Browse and manipulate repositories without checking them out
Integrates with macOS keychain and supports svn+ssh without SSH key pairs
Works with Kaleidoscope, FileMerge, BBEdit, or custom comparison scripts
caveats: Requires macOS 14.0 or later (macOS 15.0 or later recommended)
Viewing file comparisons requires Kaleidoscope or another comparison app
Pricing not stated on the page
